Dear Dr. Clayton,
Re: Ms. Tracy Bowen              
DOB :
 22/07/1988
           Thank you for seeing Ms. Bowen, a 26-year-old patient, whose symptoms and signs are suggestive of polycystic ovary syndrome. Your expert assessment and management would be highly appreciated.
Ms. Bowen has a history of childhood asthma for which she has been maintained on 
salbultamol
 inhaler and on need 
beclomethasone
. She has a stressful life since her parents` divorce in 2002.
On 28/08/2014, Ms. Bowen attended my clinic complaining of 
oligomenorrhea
 and frequent 
dysmenorrhea
 since menarche. Her examination was unremarkable. Hence she was diagnosed idiopathic 
oligomenorrhea
 with primary 
dysemonrrhea
. She was reassured and commenced on Diane 
35mg ,
 2mg and Naproxen.
Since that time, Ms. Bowen presented with progressive 
suppurative
 acne which has not improved with 
antibiotics. 
That`s why, she was referred to a dermatologist who prescribed her 
isoretenoin
 capsules and 
Isotrex
 gel.
On review today, Ms. Bowen told me she had been married and stopped her oral contraceptive pills 
sine
 January 2013.
 Additionally, Infertility and 
amennorhea
 were reported. She has suffered from depression 
and weight gain over the last period. Upon examination, she was overweight and showed 
hirsutism
. The appropriate investigations were requested and revealed high levels of fasting oral glucose tolerance 
test,
 free androgen index and 
prolactin
. Besides, Low levels of SHBG and Vit
a
min D were found. The results of androgenic hormones and TSH were in normal range.
In view on the above
, The patient was advised to start Climen
,10mg
 
qd
 and 
a pelvic ultrasound was requested. 
Please
 check the attached copy of the radiograph result.
For any queries, please contact me.
Yours Sincerely,
Doctor
